title.rendered: How to use Screen Time on Mac: A detailed guide

content.rendered:
If you spend much time in front of your Mac screen, you must track and limit your usage time. So, to help you maintain your well-being, Mac offers a great feature called Screen Time. In this guide, I will show how to set up and use Screen Time on your Mac running macOS Sonoma, including setting app limits, changing content & privacy restrictions, and much more.

What is Screen Time on Mac?

The time a person spends on the device’s screen is rising alarmingly. That’s why Apple introduced the Screen Time feature to keep track of your device usage and monitor your daily app activities. Additionally, it provides immense benefits like:

  • You can view detailed device usage reports categorized by days to take control of your daily activities accordingly. Also, you can build a habit of not overusing your device. 
  • It allows you to set limits on multiple apps. Thus, you can avoid distractions by social media, games, or other time-wasting apps and increase your productivity and efficiency.  
  • Screen Time helps parents to control their children’s screen usage. They can set limits on apps and block certain inappropriate websites or categories.  

Overall, the Screen Time feature helps you manage screen usage and promote responsible digital habits for personal use and parental control. Now, let’s learn how to turn on Screen Time on your Mac.

How to turn on Screen Time on Mac

  1. Go to the Apple logo () → Launch System Settings.

  2. Navigate to Screen Time.
  3. Click App & Website Activity.

  4. Hit Turn on App & Website Activity to enable Screen Time on your Mac.

How to use Screen Time on Mac

Now that you’ve enabled Screen Time on Mac, many features should be available to play with. Let’s explore every function of Screen Time and understand their true potential.

Set a Screen Time Passcode

If you’re wary of your privacy, setting a passcode for your Screen Time is viable. This step ensures that only you can make changes within Screen Time.

  1. Click the Apple logo () → System Settings.

  2. Choose Screen Time → Toggle on Lock Screen Time Settings.

  3. Enter the Password of your device and press Modify Configuration.
  4. Set a Screen Time Passcode of four digits and verify the same.

  5. Upon verification, use your Apple ID and Password to set up Screen Time Passcode Recovery and press Next.

You’ve now successfully set up a new Passcode for the Screen Time feature on your Mac.

Sync your Screen Time across all your Apple devices

Apple offers the Screen Time feature on every device to help you control your device’s usage. But wouldn’t it be nice if you could manage your screen activities on all devices altogether? Let’s see how to achieve that:

  1. Select Screen Time from System Settings.
  2. Toggle on Share across devices and enter the Screen Time Passcode.

This feature will better understand your screen time activities on devices with the same Apple ID. However, note that the Screen Time passcode will automatically disable as you turn on device sync on your Mac.

Viewing app usage on Mac

The Screen Time feature lets you track your corresponding app usage and monitor your activity in a detailed format. Let’s look at how to view Screen Time reports on Mac and break down the information you can expect.

  1. Access Screen Time and choose App & Website Activity.

  2. Now, you’ll see an overview of your device usage, including the apps you have used, websites visited, and time spent on each activity.

  3. Select an app or website to get more information about your usage, including how much time you spend on it each day and what times of day you use it most.

Apart from taking note of your device usage, you can also access the reports of other users connected with your Apple ID on your Mac. This feature is mainly meant for parents or guardians who desire to monitor their children’s screen usage.

Managing App Limits on Mac

By reviewing your Screen Time reports, you can identify patterns and make necessary adjustments to your device usage habits. For instance, if you spend too much time on social media platforms, you can set a runtime limit for the app.

Let’s take a closer look and learn to set up App Limit on Mac:

  1. Select App Limits from the Screen Time feature.

  2. Search for the app or category as per your preference.
    I have demonstrated the process via an application.

  3. Now, set a daily timer or personalize a custom runtime duration for the respective application.

  4. Upon customization, click Done.

  5. To disable the App Limit, access App Limits and toggle off the app you modified.

In addition to setting app limits, you can also impose limits on categories of apps, such as social networking or games, following steps 2-4. This is useful to reduce your overall screen time or avoid getting distracted by a particular category of apps.

Enable Downtime on Mac

Downtime is the ultimate approach to automatically disable activities on your Mac at a pre-determined time. Only incoming calls and the apps you choose to allow will remain active, whereas the rest of the Mac’s functions will be inaccessible.

By default, this feature is set to function at midnight, but you can set it to your preference.

  1. Select Downtime upon navigating to the Screen Time feature.

  2. Access the drop-down menu next to the Schedule option.

  3. Now, set a designated time for every day or customize it for the week accordingly.

  4. Once the settings are as per your preference, toggle on Downtime.

Now, your Mac will be deactivated at the specified time, following the cycle you’ve set. This feature can be helpful if you’re prone to overworking yourself and cannot keep track of time.

Set Always Allowed content on Mac

Preceding the system customization made via Screen Time on Mac, you can allow a series of applications to run even when Downtime is enabled. To do this:

  1. Select the Always Allowed option from the Screen Time settings.

  2. Search and toggle on the apps you seek to keep active.

The selected apps will be operational regardless of the restrictions you’ve set up or whenever Downtime is triggered on your device.

Set Communication Limits on Mac

Moving ahead, using the Screen Time feature on Mac, you can set communication in one-on-one or group conversations, including unknown numbers. The following steps will enlighten you about the setup process of the same.

  1. Select Communication Limits from the Screen Time feature.

  2. You can allow communication with selected contacts or every user when your device has Screen time enabled.

  3. Alternatively, during Downtime, you can add Specific Contacts by clicking the (+) icon.
  4. Then select Add from My Contacts or Add New Contact as your preference.

  5. Click Done to conclude the process.

Note: Set the communication restrictions in a way that you never miss any important messages or calls.

Changing Content & Privacy Restrictions

Last but not least, Screen Time also offers a feature to parents or guardians to control what their children can access on their devices.

The Content & Privacy Restrictions allow the organizer to restrict access to certain apps, websites, and features, ensuring the child’s safety and well-being.

If you’ve enabled Family Sharing on your Mac, let’s take a closer look and understand the process of turning on Content & Privacy Restrictions:

  1. Go to Content & Privacy Restrictions from Screen Time.

  2. Toggle on Content & Privacy Restrictions to access all available options.

  3. Apply Content, Store, App, and Preference Restrictions as you desire for the selected user.
  4. Click Done when the restrictions are set up to your preference.

Let’s dig deeper into these features and learn more about their functionalities:

Content Restrictions

  • Web Content: This allows you to filter the quality of content you access online.
  • Siri: It enables you to take control of the language you use to converse with Siri and manage the intensity of the content during web searches.
  • Music & TV: Organizers can allow or defy the ability to access movies and music for a user profile.
  • Game Centre: Followed by the ability to make changes while playing games, the Game Centre acts as a source of various gaming accessibilities.
  • Multiplayer Games: This menu allows the owner to make necessary changes in online multiplayer games.

Store Restrictions

  • Allowed Content: Designate the rating of the content in every entertainment domain.
  • Allowed on iOS: Choose the permissions you want your device to follow.
  • Password & Security: Set a time limit to prompt for a password while making purchases of any kind.

App Restrictions

  • Allowed: Ensure what features your device should be allowed to access.
  • Allowed on iOS: Take an overview of the features you wish to use on iPhone.

Preference Restrictions

  • Allow Changes: Set the preferences for the user ID as you desire.

Note: Upon setting up Control & Privacy Restrictions for a user, the respective profile will only be able to access the designated apps, websites, and features the organizer allows.

Get most out of Screen Time feature on Mac

Screen Time can help you regain your focus and improve your productivity exponentially, but a few tips and tricks can do wonders. Let’s have a look:

  • Don’t get carried away while setting up restrictions in Screen Time. For instance, if you set your limit too low, it may not be as beneficial as expected. Conversely, if you set your limits too high, it may be impossible for you to use your Mac.
  • Use the Downtime feature to your advantage by setting it up for your least productive hours or when you are distracted from work.
  • Customize your communication limits to fit your specific needs. For example, you may want to restrict access to social media apps during work hours but allow access during your leisure time.
  • If you’re a parent, set up Parental Controls on your child’s account to help manage their device usage. This will allow you to monitor usage reports to ensure your child uses their devices safely and responsibly.
  • Whether you want to be alerted when you reach a specific limit or have been using a particular app for too long, you can customize your notifications to match your preferences.
Can I customize my app limits for different days of the week?

Yes, you can customize your app limits for each day of the week in Screen Time on Mac. This allows you to set different limits for workdays versus weekends or according to your weekly schedule.

Can I set time limits for specific categories of apps, such as social media or games?

You can set limits for individual apps and use app categories to group your apps for easier management.

Will Screen Time on Mac automatically log me out of apps when my time limit is up?

No, Screen Time won’t automatically log you out of apps when your time limit is up. It will prevent you from accessing the app until your time limit resets. However, you can receive a notification when your time is up to remind you to take a break.

Prevent and preserve!

So go ahead and allow Screen Time to manage your digital life with greater control and transparency. With detailed reports and accurate analysis, you can make informed decisions and pivot your habits accordingly. So, implement this simple yet effective tool on Mac and see the magic in maximizing your potential.

Thank you for reading. Don’t hesitate to drop your thoughts below.

title.rendered: Best Horoscope apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Preparation is often said to be the key to success. So, many people like to surf through their daily, weekly, and monthly horoscopes. There is no harm in checking what the future holds for you and being prepared for it. So, I have curated the 12 best horoscope apps for iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Horoscope + Astrology by Yodha – Editor’s choice
  • 2. Co-Star Personalized Astrology – Editor's choice
  • 3. Nebula – Platform for astrology enthusiasts
  • 4. Time Nomad – Several zodiac calculators
  • 5. The DailyHoroscope – Free app for iPhone
  • 6. Astro Future – Use on Apple Watch
  • 7. TimePassages – Get location-based current astrology
  • 8. Astrology Zone Horoscopes – App by Susan Miller
  • 9. Daily Horoscope – Astrology – Get free Tarot readings
  • 10. Astrolis Horoscopes & Tarot – Good for Chinese astrology
  • 11. Futurio: Horoscope & Astrology – Offers palm reading
  • 12. The Pattern – Know yourself better
  • 13. Sanctuary Astrology & Psychic – Get past life readings

1. Horoscope + Astrology by Yodha – Editor’s choice

The Yodha app lets you consult with a personal astrologer and interact with an astrological community of over 200 professional Vedic astrologers. Before predicting, they thoroughly examine your birth chart, zodiac sign, pertinent circumstances, and individual considerations. You may use your birth chart readings to learn about your relationships, job, well-being, etc.

The app offers a free horoscope that is updated in real time. Also, you can get a daily dose of motivation thanks to the day’s thoughts feature. If you want to have your monthly or annual horoscope, you may request the same. For more in-depth knowledge, take the “Astrologer Selection” and “Extended Message Length” memberships.

Pros

  • Completely anonymous
  • Apple Watch support
  • A large group of professional astrologers

Cons

  • Predictions can be skeptical

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $1.99)

Download

2. Co-Star Personalized Astrology – Editor’s choice

We often read horoscopes based on our sun sign, but don’t you think that’s too generic? Co-Star horoscope app for iPhone uses the sky map of the exact time and place of birth and NASA’s data to track the planet’s current movements. An AI complies with all the data to present you with a hyper-personalized horoscope. You can even avail of a personality analysis customized to your astrological chart.

This exclusivity has earned the app praise from various publishings, including the New York Times, Buzzfeed, the Guardian, Cosmo, Vogue, and more. As per the app, the movements of the moon, other solar system planets, and the 12 zodiac houses represent/affect different parts of your life. For instance, a Libra moon or a Virgo rising will affect an Aries Sun. Thus, it offers planet-by-planet compatibility and real-time updates on planets’ movements.

Pros

  • Powerful AI that uses NASA’s data
  • Hyper-personalized
  •  Planet-by-planet compatibility

Cons

  • No significant cons

3. Nebula – Platform for astrology enthusiasts

If you are an astrology enthusiast, join Nebula’s worldwide multipurpose portal. It is available in more than 50 countries and in 6 languages. With the assistance of a strong community and highly individualized forecast, you may discover your path to happiness. Besides, all professionals on this app have passed a three-stage exam.

Therefore, you will get accurate answers and in-depth analysis. I liked the Nebulatalk forum, which provides a secure environment for like-minded individuals. So, you may communicate, get assistance, discover new things, and have fun. Besides, it offers free access to your daily, weekly, monthly, and annual horoscopes. 

Also, get your daily biorhythm charts, and learn about the lunar cycles, your polarity, modality, and sun and moon signs. You may improve your relationships using the 28-day relationship guide and compatibility section. Additionally, it offers educational resources about zodiac signs, flowers and birthstones, planets, and stars.

Pros

  • A community of over 12 million
  • Natal chart
  • Tarot card reading

Cons

  • Have payment issues

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $2.99)

Download

4. Time Nomad – Several zodiac calculators

An all-inclusive horoscope app for iOS devices, you’ll know this the moment you open the app. The dashboard is strewn with potent information such as phases of the Sun, the Moon, retrograde planets, Moon Void of Course, solar return, lunar returns, the lunar month, solar-lunar arc, etc.

You can even call upon an astrological chart at any time and location. An advanced planetary position calculator software calculates an accurate birth chart. The endless list of features includes calculators for the sidereal zodiac, tropical zodiac, retrograde planets, natal chart, numerical astrology, and planetary hours, including a planetary hour alarm.

It allows unlimited personal astrological profiles, with data stored on the iCloud account; no login is required. Further, a blog acts as a virtual astrology trainer and offers regular weekly astrology lessons and predictions. Maybe that is why the app is renowned and considered one of the best free horoscope apps for iPhone and iPad.

Pros

  • Moon Nodes Direction feature
  • Several Astrological widgets
  • All data stored on your iCloud account

Cons

  • No significant cons

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

5. The DailyHoroscope – Free app for iPhone

The DailyHoroscope is arguably the most accurate and compelling free astrology app for iPhone. Receive daily updates about your daily, weekly, and monthly horoscope. You can also get Chinese horoscopes, zodiac sign compatibility, and zodiac characteristics for each zodiac sign.

If you believe in the Druid horoscope, then the app lets you explore that as well. Did you miss a day or two and want to check past horoscopes? Scroll up to a week’s readings. The app lets you schedule reminders for special days. Moreover, you can even change the app settings to employ custom colors and font sizes per your preference.

Pros

  • Seasonal themes for personalization
  • Know zodiac characteristics
  • Druid horoscope

Cons

  • No personalized readings are available

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $5.99)

Download

6. Astro Future – Use on Apple Watch

Astro Future, the daily horoscope app for iPhone, allows you to read your daily horoscope from your home screen widget. Also, you may add unlimited family, friends, and loved ones. And then, check Synastry charts to know how others affect your horoscope. If you are a beginner, don’t worry! It provides free birth charts with horoscopes with their meaning in astrology. 

Also, you can get your natal chart and daily transit chart. And all these horoscope reports can be converted to a PDF. Moreover, the app has a compatibility checking section. Plan your days for significant astrological events like retrogrades and planetary birthdays and astronomical events like lunar and solar eclipses, solstices, and equinoxes.

Pros

  • Extensive PDF reports
  • Apple Watch support
  • Amazing widgets and dark mode

Cons

  • Has a learning curve

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $3.99)

Download

7. TimePassages – Get location-based current astrology 

As the name suggests, this horoscope app for iPhone and iPad keeps track of the passing time and how the Sun, Moon, and Rising signs affect your life. You get detailed descriptions of the house position for the sun and moon in your chart, along with a daily horoscope. Also, it employs your phone’s GPS to chart the current position and present current astrology up to the very minute.

Check the moon phases and upcoming Mercury retrograde periods from the home screen itself. Additionally, you can compare your birth chart with the current transits under a paid service. Save multiple profiles of friends & family with pictures to check their predictions. Thanks to its comprehensive astrology glossary, the app is a great option for both beginners and experienced astrologers.

Pros

  • Calculation of Sun, Moon, and Rising sign
  • Personalized astrology dashboard
  • Compare precision charts with other

Cons

  • No explanation for Lilith or nodal placements

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

8. Astrology Zone Horoscopes – App by Susan Miller

Astrology Zone is an award-winning horoscope app for iPhone created by Susan Miller, a renowned astrologer. It offers comprehensive daily and monthly horoscopes. The daily horoscope includes forecasts for yesterday, today, and tomorrow. Also, you will get a preview of the next week every Sunday.

If you have missed checking the last month’s horoscope, don’t worry! It will be available along with the current month’s reading. Also, you can get compatibility reports and read essays on different topics like Mercury retrograde, eclipses, conventional birth signs, etc. The best part is it includes a Learn Astrology area to learn about your planets, elements, traits, etc.

Pros

  • Short daily horoscopes
  • Compatibility reports
  • Get last month’s monthly horoscope

Cons

  • No personalized readings or live chat

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $4.99)

9. Daily Horoscope – Astrology – Get free Tarot readings

This iPhone horoscope app offers precise and detailed daily horoscopes. So, you may get accurate predictions for work, love, health, today’s compatibility, and today’s Lucky Numbers. Besides, it provides different Tarot card readings like love, money, etc. Know your rising sun and compatibility with other signs from your zodiac chart.

You may read Chinese and Druid horoscopes, your daily Moon Forecast, and crack Fortune Cookies in the Astrology Zone. Also, you can learn about love horoscope, galaxy tarot, astrological chart, nebula planets, and Co star’s spin. The app lets you save and share your readings. I must say it has a user-friendly layout.

Pros

  • Crystal ball prophecy
  • Follow the motion of moons
  • Detailed daily horoscope

Cons

  • No option for a free trial

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $2.99)

While getting ready for the day, why not prepare for the situation that may lie ahead. Get a daily horoscope based on planetary position and prepare yourself accordingly. A simple 5-star system gives daily ratings for money, energy, love, and mood for the day. Further, avail weekly and monthly horoscopes to glimpse your future.

If you are grappled by a particular question, use the tarot card feature for a better understanding and probable solution. For romantic hearts, the daily forecast will reveal the zodiac sign that will be your love match for the day. And not just yours; read all 12 zodiac signs within the app.

Pros

  • Find true Chinese zodiac signs
  • View daily compatibility
  • Daily new three-card tarot reading

Cons

  • Very basic UI

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $1.49)

Futurio is among the astrology apps for iPhone that delve deeper into their stars from skilled astrologers. It offers precise daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly horoscope forecasts, dream dictionaries, lunar calendars, tarot, and palm readings. Also, know about your zodiac sign’s primary features and compatibility information.

For accuracy, all predictions are based on your birth date, time, and location. The app provides in-depth insight into all aspects of life to help you keep emotionally, spiritually, and financially on track. Besides, you may use your birth chart report for self-discovery and sound decision-making. Moreover, get compatibility in job, sex, marriage, and friendship with others.

Pros

  • Get answers from astrologers
  • Unique human code
  • Expert relationship advice

Cons

  • No horoscope reports
  • Repeated horoscopes

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $2.99)

12. The Pattern – Know yourself better

The Pattern is a unique astrology app for iPhone that provides a psychological blueprint of your distinct personality qualities. It is a mirror for an in-depth look at the significant cycles you may experience throughout your life. Also, you can check individual compatibility with friends and love interests using Pattern’s patented technology. 

Therefore, you can create connections on a much deeper level. Also, the app lets you create a profile for anybody to learn about your commonalities. I liked its shared experiences aspect. Here, you can connect with the community by sharing and learning about how unique characteristics influence each of us.

Pros

  • Know about your patterns
  • Get daily vibes
  • Review your bonds

Cons

  • Not traditional astrology and horoscope

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

Along with a free daily horoscope for all twelve zodiac signs, the Sanctuary Astrology & Psychic app includes some interesting features. It offers an interactive birth chart and live, on-demand personalized readings. Besides, you can draw a daily tarot card and crystal with a special message. This virtual lucky charm will help you cross many regular hurdles.

If you love being updated about horoscopes, then a daily dose of astrology will be delivered to your device. Also, the astrological sign calculator assesses your relationships based on the five areas of love compatibility. You can even avail of a 5-minute personalized reading and live chat with an astrologer for only $4.99 as a welcome gift.

Pros

  • 100+ professional readers
  •  Astrology Live Chat
  • Daily crystal reading

Cons

  • The forecast is sun-focused

title.rendered: Best iPhone sports games in 2026

content.rendered:
Sports games on mobile devices have always tried their best to emulate the realism found in physical games. Thankfully, the recent advancements in technology have helped them deliver better. If you’re looking for the best iPhone sports games, look no further than this list.

I’ve curated a vast range of sports games for you to check out. Let’s have a look at them!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Table Tennis Touch
  • 2. Golf Blitz
  • 3. Madden NFL 22 Mobile Football
  • 4. MLB Perfect Inning 23
  • 5. Touchgrind BMX 2
  • 6. Real Boxing 2
  • 7. FIFA Soccer
  • 8. Skate City
  • 9. Real Cricket 20
  • 10. NBA Live Mobile Basketball

1. Table Tennis Touch

One look at Table Tennis Touch, and you might mistake it for a simple tennis game with quirky graphics. In truth, it’s much more than that. Table Tennis Touch is highly rated on the App Store, and it’s easy to see why.

The game has a full-fledged career mode, allowing you to grow from small Clubs to World Tournaments. Essentially, you start as a small player in local Clubs to become a World Champion. Moreover, you get to play in different leagues and special events.

If you don’t have the time or energy for a full-fledged match, there are different game modes, with smaller formats such as Half Tables and Accuracy Zones. You can also play with your friends and challenge them to find the best table tennis player. There’s also an offline mode, so you can challenge the AI while traveling.

Table Tennis Touch has a certain level of customization, too. As you progress, you will unlock different bats with specific stats. You can choose a bat that works with your play style. Besides, realism is an important aspect. You’ll be glad to know that the game has realistic physics and collision systems.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

2. Golf Blitz

This isn’t your typical golf game or simulator. It’s not a golf scoring or news app, either. This is a unique way to play golf, and considering how highly it’s been rated, Golf Blitz is here to stay.

The game features extensive golf courses with crazy designs. You compete against the game’s artificial intelligence or your friends in multiplayer to get to the top of the clubhouse and complete the course. You can customize both your golfer and the golf ball you are using.

As you level up, you can use your experience points to change your avatar’s skills to suit your style. There are 16 different golf balls to choose from, and each of them is unique in its way. There’s plenty of content in this game to sieve through. So, I guarantee that you won’t get bored after a few hours of gameplay.

Golf Blitz may not be for golf enthusiasts. However, it’s a worthwhile game for casual gamers.

Price: Free (In-game purchases start at $0.99)

Download

3. Madden NFL 22 Mobile Football

Madden NFL 22 provides the most authentic football experience on mobile devices. It offers the best managerial mode in US football. Create your All-Star Football team and guide them to glory.

Since the game’s previous iterations, the trading system has been revamped to include more variety when building your team. The only way to the top of the leaderboards is to build and improve your team continuously. You can mix and match different players to find which combination grants your team the best overall score.

Once you’ve created your team, battle through the NFL season and challenge the best players. You can also relive the best moments in Super Bowl history and play a part in achieving stardom. The visuals have also been upgraded to provide more realism.

Overall, Madden NFL 22 delivers an unparalleled experience, making it a must-have for football fans.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

4. MLB Perfect Inning 23

Baseball has often been overlooked in sports games. Until recently, neither were they receiving much coverage nor passion projects. That changed when MLB Perfect Inning 23 came to the fore. The game has revolutionized how people view baseball games on mobile devices.

MLB Perfect Inning 23 brings to life the real players that play the popular game, with motion technology capturing their stances and play style. Moreover, the graphics have been overhauled to bring more realism.

Over 30 famous ballparks are in the game to create the atmosphere and ambiance of a real game. Control your favorite team in the home stadiums as you take in the feel of being in a Major League Baseball match. You can also play the game online with your friends and trade your players in the authentic FA market.

If you are interested in getting to know baseball better, MLB Perfect Inning 23 is an excellent place to start. For enthusiasts, the game provides in-depth gameplay with an emphasis on authenticity. There’s something for everyone.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

5. Touchgrind BMX 2

As a kid, watching the X Games Asia highlights on the sports channels drew me towards extreme sports. One of my favorite games was the BMX series. Most video games were unable to recreate the danger and adventure that physical sports provided. Touchgrind BMX 2 has changed that completely.

Appl declared its first version as one of the best games for iPhone in 2011. The developers have taken the game’s core and added improvements to it to release Touchgrind BMX 2. Suffice it to say that the game has been a massive hit with users in the App Store.

Experience extreme bike riding in detailed environments. The objective is to complete the tracks while performing the most dangerous stunts and tricks. The game has plenty of variety, from jumping over canyons to shredding trails in mountain tracks.

You can also design your BMX bicycle to suit your playstyle and aesthetics. Numerous challenges are provided for you and your friends to complete. You can also compete against each other in events to see who comes out on top.

The controls are easy to understand but challenging to master. This makes the wins even more satisfactory. For those who want to try something new, Touchgrind BMX 2 is a perfect choice.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

6. Real Boxing 2

You’ll be hard-pressed to find people who don’t enjoy boxing or the Rocky movies. It has become one of the biggest sports globally, drawing millions of people and money. While boxing games have been good on consoles, the Real Boxing series has brought the game authentically to mobile devices.

In Real Boxing 2, you start a career from the bottom and fight your way to the top of the boxing world. Face the elite champions to claim your stake at the very top. You can also face unique limited-time bosses. Defeat the bosses, and you will be granted better gear.

Further, you can also use special attacks and Focus abilities to defeat your opponent, apart from the usual jabs and uppercuts. There’s also an MMO element to the game as you can face opponents worldwide. Play ranked matches to become the best boxer in the virtual world.

The gameplay and graphics have been updated for the next generation of gaming. This means that you can get the most realistic atmospheres and fight in the grandest of arenas in front of a capacity crowd. A must-play for boxing lovers.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

7. FIFA Soccer

I can’t talk about sports games without talking about FIFA Soccer. The football franchise has been going strong since the mid-1990s and hasn’t taken a break since. It’s one of the world’s biggest gaming franchises for consoles and mobile devices. With the latest updates, FIFA Soccer brings the popular game to iPhones.

The main draw for this game is that you can create your team from scratch. Play ranked matches to get rewards and unlock better players. You can also complete monthly challenges for squad building to acquire the in-form players. The game is updated regularly, and the players’ ratings are changed to reflect their real form.

Further, you can also play online against your friends and other players worldwide to raise the rankings. Like other freemium games, you will have to pay real cash to unlock players faster. You can grind to get both players and perks. However, this will take much longer.

There are various licensed players, teams, and clubs to choose from as you continue building your squad. In fact, the FIFA games have the highest number of sponsored teams in any soccer game. Moreover, its iconic gameplay continues to improve with new updates and iterations.

If you love football, this is a game you should have on your iPhone.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

You can download the best FIFA World Cup Wallpapers for iPhone.

8. Skate City

Skaters such as Tony Hawk have made incredible efforts to popularize the sport. Its lifestyle and beliefs have become a part of teenage culture. It’s with these beliefs that Skate City has been developed. The developers have taken the time and care to produce a true skating game for mobile devices.

The aesthetics of Skate City are lo-fi and minimalistic, with a unique art style capturing the essence of skating. This creates the perfect ambiance for the game itself. As for gameplay, Skate City features multiple environments with dynamic weather. Day changes to night, and the weather changes on a whim. This changes the conditions for your skating as well.

Many famous skating cities, such as Oslo and Barcelona, are featured. The concrete jungles of these significant cities become your backyard for skating and pulling the ‘gnarliest’ of tricks. Different tricks exist, such as the established kickflips and ollies. You can also try to nail new tricks with the control scheme.

You can take up challenges in different cities or roam freely and explore the cities themselves. Gather enough points to upgrade your character and customize your skateboards and the character’s abilities. Play the game the way you want to.

Price: Free (Comes with Apple Arcade subscriptions)

Download

9. Real Cricket 20

Cricket is one of the biggest sports in the world, being established in England in the Asian countries. It is slowly establishing itself in different parts of the Western world as well. Real Cricket 20 is the virtual fix for cricket connoisseurs looking for an authentic cricket game on iPhones.

The game has so much depth and realism that it isn’t even classified as Arcade on the App Store. It’s been placed in the Simulation genre and does justice to the classification. Real Cricket 20 features world-famous stadiums around the world, with licensed teams and players.

Sanjay Manjrekar, a legend of the game and famous commentator, lends his voice to add more variety and give a real cricket match vibe. You can play in tournaments as you play for the world’s best cricket team. You can also play online against opponents in tournaments that yield rewards on completion.

Real Cricket 21 had been slated for release in April 2021. Unfortunately, it has faced unavoidable delays. Until the new iteration of Real Cricket releases, Real Cricket 20 will satisfy your cricket cravings.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.49)

Download

10. NBA Live Mobile Basketball

Basketball is a major sport, with the world’s biggest athletes finding their footing in the game. NBA Live Mobile Basketball is the latest iteration from EA to contribute to the genre.

With Season 6 releasing, you can draft your favorite players into the lineup of your preferred teams. Create your dream team and fight for the top spots. Keep playing matches to increase your team’s overall and play against the world’s best players.

There are multiple challenges to complete as you play multiplayer matches. This includes limited-time events to complete and gather unique items to better your team’s performances in LIVE Today matches. There are campaigns throughout the season to play and build your team.

NBA Live Mobile Basketball provides some of the best gameplay mechanics. Give it a try if you love basketball!

Price: Free (In-game purchases start at $1.99)

Download

That’s it!

Sports games can either be casual or simulations. Either way, they provide multiple options without taking much of your free time. This makes these sports games for iPhone the perfect companion for your boredom. What do you think? If you have more suggestions, I’d love to read them in the comments!

title.rendered: Best recipe apps for iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Cooking at home is both healthier and more cost-effective. I’ve compiled a list of the best recipe apps for your iPhone or iPad to help you prepare delicious meals tailored to your preferences, cravings, and ingredients available. Cook up a storm today!

Table of Contents
  • 1. JustTheRecipe Easy cooking: Your personal digital cookbook
  • 2. Tasty – Recipes, Cooking Videos: Experiment with savory cuisines
  • 3. DishCapture: Best for Saving Any Recipe, From Anywhere
  • 4. BigOven Recipes & Meal Planner: Best cooking community
  • 5. Fit Men Cook for healthy recipes
  • 6. Paprika Recipe manager 3
  • 7. SuperCook Recipe by Ingredient

1. JustTheRecipe Easy cooking: Your personal digital cookbook

If food is your love, JustTheRecipe is for you. This all-in-one app is an ideal companion for anyone who wants to enjoy scrumptious food without getting lost in the pool of information included in recipe blogs. JustTheRecipe app cuts down all the fluff and gives you easy access to the two most essential elements of a cooking recipe – ingredients and instructions. Hop on to cooking straight away! 

The platform allows you to create a digital cookbook to save and group your favorite recipes into collections. This can include your recipes, too. In addition, there is complete freedom to customize ingredients or the making process per your taste. Moreover, you can include fancy images and special notes to make your digital cookbook even more enjoyable.   

In the premium version, the app allows you to take printouts of your recipes. Moreover, you can adjust the servings of these recipes based on the number of guests. This way, you can easily avoid cooking more or less than the required quantity. The in-built AI-powered unit converter further simplifies your cooking.  

Pros

  • Direct access to ingredients and instructions 
  • Personalized cookbook 
  • Simple and intuitive interface 
  • Extra benefits on premium 

Cons

  • No cons found 

Price: In-app purchases start at $1.49)

Download  

2. Tasty – Recipes, Cooking Videos: Experiment with savory cuisines

As the name suggests, Tasty is your one-stop app for all things delicious! It’s got over 4000 recipes at your fingertips presented in a nifty step-by-step instruction mode. This means they’re super easy to replicate. Trust me, given my clumsiness and lack of culinary skill, if I can do it, anyone can!

I love the ‘My Recipes’ page, which functions like your mobile cookbook. It’s ideal for those who love the nostalgic charm of hardbound cookbooks passed down through the generations.

The search tool is incredibly powerful and lets you filter by ingredients, cuisine, and social occasion. So, you’re never lost for what to cook up!

The detailed personalization makes Tasty one of the best free recipe apps for the iPhone. You can find hundreds of recipes that match your dietary needs, such as vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and more.

Further, one of my favorite features is “What’s in Your Kitchen.” This lets you find recipes based on what ingredients you have. Just select three ingredients you have, and the app will recommend recipes based on that.

Pros

  • Great for beginners
  • Extensive collection of recipes
  • Caters to varied dietary needs
  • Find recipes for ingredients you have

Cons

  • Some recipes are not accurately categorized. For instance, you might see an egg recipe in the vegetarian section.

Price: Free (In-App Purchase – Monthly $3)

Download

3. DishCapture: Best for Saving Any Recipe, From Anywhere

We were excited to test this newly launched app, which is already gaining traction with early users. DishCapture grew out of a very relatable moment: four friends fighting over the last piece of chocolate cake and everyone wanting the recipe. That sparked a bigger question for them: why were their favorite recipes still scattered across their homes and kitchens, buried in screenshots, saved Instagram and Facebook posts, websites, printouts, cookbooks and old family recipe cards?

What we liked is that DishCapture was created by a non-techie home cook who simply wanted a solution, not by a big software company trying to invent another recipe app. It feels like an app built to solve a problem many home cooks genuinely have.

DishCapture uses the technology of AI to help capture a recipe from a screenshot, photo, Instagram, Facebook or TikTok post, website URL, pasted text or dictation, then turns it into a clean, editable recipe stored in one searchable library. You can even photograph a handwritten or printed family recipe card and preserve it forever.

One feature we particularly liked is that DishCapture retains the original recipe and its source, so users can always return to where the recipe came from. The keyword search is also genuinely useful: search by an ingredient such as “banana,” a cooking method such as “steam,” or even a personal word such as “Mom.”

We found that recipes could be edited, organized, printed and easily shared. They even solved the issue of touching your phone or tablet with sticky fingers by introducing hands-free cooking controls, which help users move through recipe instructions with simple voice commands.

Another feature worth watching is the smart, shareable shopping list that DishCapture plans to launch soon. It is designed to take into account ingredients users already have in their fridge or cupboards, helping avoid unnecessary purchases, and the finished list can even be shared with someone else doing the shopping.

Pros

  • Captures recipes from photos, screenshots, social media, websites, and text
  • AI converts recipes into clean, editable recipes
  • Powerful keyword search
  • Easy to edit, organize, print, and share
  • Hands-free cooking mode

Cons

  • No strict meal categories like breakfast, lunch, or dinner
  • No nutritional or calorie information

Download

4. BigOven Recipes & Meal Planner: Best cooking community

When it comes to cooking inspiration, BigOven has got you covered with big ideas! No more digging through old cookbooks or frantically searching online to find something to cook. Just collect your favorite recipes in this app from all your favorite sites and organize them in folders to quickly find them later on.

The highlight is the vibrant community of home cooks who share your passion and keep you motivated to stay in the kitchen. You can find your favorite community members and their recipes on your home screen. Plus, read reviews left by others and get notified of comments or questions on recipes you’ve posted.

Further, you can enjoy even more benefits when you upgrade to the ad-free BigOven Pro membership. For instance, you can upload unlimited recipes and find more that cater to your diet and lifestyle with ingredient-by-ingredient nutritional insights and advanced search filters.

Additionally, create custom folders to store recipes for any occasion. And plan and share a week’s worth of meals across multiple BigOven accounts.

Pros

  • Keeps all your recipes in one place
  • A vibrant community of cooking enthusiasts
  • Feature-rich

Cons

  • Compatibility issues with certain websites

Price: Free (Pro starts at $1.99)

Download

5. Fit Men Cook for healthy recipes

I think we are well past the gender stereotype of only women doing the cooking. So here’s a recipe app that primarily caters to men who want to stay fit. While working out is essential, the root of your health is in the kitchen. Get dozens of meal ideas in varied categories, such as post-workout snacks, low-carb lunches, etc.

This app will change your mind if you think that healthy food is tasteless or boring. It guides you with easy-to-make nutritious meals that will help you stick to a healthy diet without spending a lot of compromising on variety.

Along with step-by-step instructions, it helps with meal planning, grocery shopping, and macro counting for bodybuilding or weight loss. All in all, a remarkable tool that will inspire you to take charge of your health.

Pros

  • Encourages healthy eating
  • Recipes for different diet plans and fitness needs
  • Specially catered to men
  • Great for cooking newbies and pros alike

Cons

  • A bit pricey

Price: $3.99 (Additional in-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

6. Paprika Recipe manager 3

If you love collecting recipes the way I do, you need this app in your life! It’s perfect for organizing every aspect of your meals, from grocery lists and meal plans to recipes from your favorite websites. It beautifully syncs across devices so that you can access it anytime, anywhere.

What’s more? You can import from other apps such as MacGourmet, YummySoup!, MasterCook & Living Cookbook. Lastly, keeping things organized and sharing recipes is a breeze. It’s straightforward to use and makes it convenient to catalog all your food needs in one app.

Given the all-around utility, I’m sure you’ll use Paprika for years to come, which makes it well worth the one-time price!

Pros

  • Comprehensive app
  • Highly customizable
  • Well-designed and functional

Cons

  • Manual entry for personal recipes

Price: $4.99

Download

7. SuperCook Recipe by Ingredient

How many times have you found a tempting recipe only to realize you’re missing some key ingredients? Say goodbye to that sinking feeling and try this smart recipe app that suggests meals based on what you already have.

To get started, navigate to the pantry page of the app and choose all the ingredients you have from a list of over 2000. Categories include fruits, vegetables, meats, oils, sauces, spices, and more. Then, SuperCook will work its magic by curating the perfect recipes that match your ingredients.

When you run out of something, remove it from your pantry to automatically adjust your recipe recommendations.

This app boasts millions of recipes from thousands of websites in 20 languages. It’s inspired my creativity in the kitchen and is a must-have for anyone who wants to cook more.

Pros

  • Super easy to use
  • Recipes in 20 languages
  • Helpful for people with dietary restrictions

Cons

  • Lack of unique or innovative recipes

Price: Free

Download

title.rendered: Best Jigsaw Puzzle Games for iPhone

content.rendered:
Jigsaw puzzle games have been a well-liked category, coming a long way from simple picture-rearrangement games to ones with solid plots and appealing visuals. Also, they are fun and instructive since they test cognitive abilities and develop children’s intellectual skills. However, finding the best jigsaw puzzle games is never easy. Therefore, I have compiled a list of the top jigsaw puzzle games for iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Jigsaw Puzzles – Editor's choice
  • 2. Jigsaw Puzzles for Adults – Use your own photos
  • 3. Magic Jigsaw Puzzles – In-game music library
  • 4. Jigsaw Puzzle – For Disney lovers
  • 5. Jigsaw Puzzle Ultimate – Completely free
  • 6. Jigsaw Puzzles Plus – With soothing music
  • 7. Jigsaw Puzzles Epic – Fully HD optimized
  • 8. Puzzle Games – For beginners
  • 9. Jigsawscapes – Play offline
  • 10. Art Puzzle – Jigsaw coloring game

1. Jigsaw Puzzles – Editor’s choice

  • Requirements: iOS 11.0 or later

You will get a captivating experience with over 13,000 adorable HD graphics. So, you can de-stress and have hours of fun while exercising your short-term memory and focus. It offers lots of free, high-quality images. You can choose from several categories: colors, flowers, nature, animals, art, landmarks, etc.

Also, you will never get bored as it releases a new free puzzle daily. When you complete the puzzle, you will earn coins and spend them on specialized collections and puzzles. I liked the game events and exclusive postcard rewards. If you get stuck, use Hint to fit the next puzzle piece.

Choosing 400 puzzle pieces mode and turning on rotation can make your game more challenging. Besides, the individual backgrounds allow you to select your preferred look.

Pros

  • Personalize the difficulty levels
  • Get hints

Cons

  • Noisy ads

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

2. Jigsaw Puzzles for Adults – Use your own photos

  • Requirements: iOS 12.0 or later

This puzzle game for iPhone and iPad offers over 10,000 free jigsaw puzzles and adds new ones daily. You may upload your photos to create puzzles. I liked their 12 different levels of difficulty. So, at your convenience, you can choose from 12 to 440 puzzle pieces. Also, the huge collections of 17+ categories have every kind of image you want. 

The app allows you to set the backdrop color and puzzle piece shape to get a more personalized vibe. For each puzzle independently, you may enable or disable the piece rotation. Besides, before holidays like Christmas, Halloween, and Easter, they come up with special puzzle packs.

The game receives a significant update on Wednesday, including several large puzzle packs. I personally work on numerous jigsaw puzzles at once, and its autosave feature helps store the progress. But it needs some upgrades to work smoothly.

Pros

  • Weekly big puzzle packs
  • 17+ categories

Cons

  • Problems in saving the progress

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

3. Magic Jigsaw Puzzles – In-game music library

  • Requirements: iOS 13.0 or later

The Magic jigsaw puzzle is a widely popular game with 100 million global downloads. It’s over 30,000 HD puzzle gallery has special collections from Disney, Pixar, and Nickelodeon. Also, you may use your photos as puzzles. I liked its in-game music library that allows you to choose your favorite song to go along with your stress-relieving puzzle sessions.

In its 6 levels of difficulty, you can choose 1200 pieces as the highest. Besides, it allows attempting many puzzles at once to track your development. Also, you may solve the problem by looking at the final image. To make the game more challenging, turn on the rotation mode and move the pieces in groups. Magic Jigsaw Puzzles has the greatest online community where you can participate in weekly competitions.

Pros

  • Weekly competitions
  • Great Magic Jigsaw Puzzles community

Cons

  • The app freezes sometimes

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

4. Jigsaw Puzzle – For Disney lovers

  • Requirements: iOS 11.0 or later

This jigsaw puzzle game has collaborated with Disney to offer fantasy puzzles of Mickey & Friends, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, Beauty and the Beast, etc. There are over 25,000 HD images with daily free puzzle addition. If you are playing on the iPad, you may choose from 9 to 1024 pieces for the iPad. And for iPhone, it allows for 9 to 400 pieces.

Besides, you will never be bored as the app provides free puzzle packs for download and launches new ones each week. When you solve puzzles, you will get bonuses, and you can use those jigsaw credits to purchase new puzzle packs. Also, you can save your completed puzzles and share them with others. I liked the game center leaderboard feature with 40+ different goals to complete.

Pros

  • Good for kids
  • Leaderboard goals

Cons

  • Distracting ads

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

5. Jigsaw Puzzle Ultimate – Completely free

  • Requirements: iOS 9.0 or later

If you are looking for completely free jigsaw puzzle games for iPhone and iPad, here it is. This offers 14,000 puzzles and 500 sets of puzzles. Besides, you can use your images to make puzzles. On your iPad, the puzzles have 625 pieces or more. But there are only 100 pieces of puzzles on iPhone and iPod. The piece rotation and ranking board feature a level of difficulty and make your game more enjoyable.

Pros

  • Free 14,000 puzzles
  • Ranking boards

Cons

  • The gaming interface needs improvement

Price: Free

Download

6. Jigsaw Puzzles Plus – With soothing music

  • Requirements: iOS 9.3 or later

The Jigsaw Puzzle Plus game is ideal for older iPhone versions as it runs on iOS 9.3 or later. You can enjoy HD images’ jigsaw puzzles in various categories. As it’s designed for iPad, you need to play in landscape mode on iPhone. Also, you may choose the puzzle’s size and degree of difficulty. I loved the soothing music and other tranquil sounds it offers to calm the mind and reduce mental stress.

Pros

  • Different-shaped puzzle pieces
  • No ads

Cons

  • No puzzles of the day

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

7. Jigsaw Puzzles Epic – Fully HD optimized

  • Requirements: iOS 11.0 or later

The Jigsaw Puzzles Epic has over 10,000 HD puzzles in over 250 distinct bundles. You may also use your photographs to make puzzles. Besides, every puzzle is unique since the pieces are all of different shapes. The best part is it offers daily free puzzles and regularly updates the puzzle packs. 

The app has 11 levels of difficulty with over 625 pieces, offering various challenges to complete. Also, you can check your ranking, thanks to the integration of Leaderboards and Achievements with Game Center. Besides, you can work on many puzzles at once by saving all of them in progress.

Pros

  • Simple to play
  • Option to disable zoom and snapping

Cons

  • Lack of puzzle piece shapes

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $1.99)

Download

8. Puzzle Games – For beginners

  • Requirements: iOS 10.0 or later

If you love nature photos in HD, this puzzle app is perfect for you. It offers new puzzles daily, and you can view them monthly calendar-wise. Also, the intriguing challenges keep you returning to play. You may also save your solved puzzles in a collection.

The personalization allows you to set over 625 pieces and autosave your progress. But there is no landscape mode that is not good for iPads. And you need to learn how to use the controls via trial and error since there is no in-game assistance to explain what they do.

Pros

  • Special events
  • Tiles mode

Cons

  • No landscape mode
  • No in-game help

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $0.99)

Download

9. Jigsawscapes – Play offline

  • Requirements: iOS 10.0 or later

Popular and compelling Jigsawscapes offers over 7000 puzzles to develop your brain and add 20 new puzzles daily, available offline and online. The puzzles are intended to provide relaxation to both novice and experienced gamers. Also, you may customize the difficulty level by adjusting the number of pieces for each problem. 

Besides, you can create your Puzzle Collection to save all completed puzzles in one location. The custom backdrop feature allows you to use your preferred background while playing. I must say this app has a user-friendly design, simple controls, and a clean structure. So people of all ages can enjoy the game.

Pros

  • No need for internet
  • User-friendly design

Cons

  • Costly subscription

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $6.99)

Download

10. Art Puzzle – Jigsaw coloring game

  • Requirements: iOS 12.0 or later

Art Puzzle offers jigsaw puzzles and coloring books together. Here, you can solve puzzles by piecing vibrant animated artwork together. Each puzzle is unique. Besides, you can enjoy thousands of images from various artists, each with their distinctive technique and style. If you are stuck on a puzzle, look for hints to complete them quickly.

Pros

  • Animated puzzles
  • Only one hint on iPhone

Cons

  • Confusing clue lines

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $4.99)

Download

So, that’s all for today, folks!

The jigsaw puzzle games are perfect for both kids and adults. I love making puzzles from my photos and sharing them with my friends. Which app will you download to play? Let me know in the comments below. Also, explore other games for iPhone and iPad…

  • 29 Best Apple Arcade Games
  • Best card games for iPhone and iPad 
  • Best city builder games for iPhone and iPad

title.rendered: Best stock trading apps for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
The modern world requires us to have multiple sources of income. Investing in stocks is a great way to accomplish this. What if you don’t know anything about investing in the stock market? Is it even possible to pick the best iPhone stock trading app among the gazillion available on the App Store? 

This guide will help you choose the best one. But before that, let us help clear the basics to boost your confidence in online financial investing.

Note: I have compiled this list of the best trading apps after testing each for more than 30 parameters. These apps are accessible through your iPhones, iPad as well as laptops. Most of these apps can be operated using Apple Watch as well, so you never miss an update from your leading share.

Table of Contents
  • Are investment apps safe?
  • How to choose an online stock trading app?
  • 5+ Best stock trading apps for iPhone and iPad
    • 1. R StocksTrader: Editor's Choice
    • 2. Fidelity Investments: Best for mutual funds
    • 3. E*TRADE: Best for day trading
    • 4. Robinhood: Best for beginners
    • 5. Ally: Best for banking benefits
    • 6. Webull: Best stock app for minors

Are investment apps safe?

Yes. Investment apps are 100% secure; you do not have to worry about that. Consider these apps to be a shop that lets you make the purchase. Let us understand this with an example.

For instance, if you wish to buy a piece of furniture for your abode, you will go to IKEA. Substitute IKEA with your best stock broker app, and that’s it! 

Well, that does make it sound a little easy. But you may wonder, how to choose the one for you? If you are a beginner, you will need an app that spoon-feeds you the information and helps you learn and invest simultaneously.

How to choose an online stock trading app?

While picking up the right app, you need to understand the services provided rather than the stocks because companies remain the same regardless of the platform.

Moreover, the best stock trading apps for beginners will have $0 or a low brokerage and ETF trades and cater to a fully-featured online trading experience. 

There are several other factors, such as the platform’s safety, brokerage, miscellaneous charges, etc. But don’t get overwhelmed!

I have covered a few essential points below that I wish someone had told me when I started trading:

  • Quick and timely execution: Your trading platform should facilitate the trades quickly and with utmost precision. The prices fluctuate every second, and you do not want to miss a good deal. Every cent counts!
  • Safe to use: The app will carry your private information and a lot of money. Thus, it has to offer top-notch security. 
  • Simple UI: For a stock app, it is essential to keep the interface simple. Buying or selling a stock should be possible with two or three taps on your screen. A complicated process takes up a lot of time, and you may miss the entry point. 
  • Diversity: You need an app that is as diverse as Rachel’s trifle. It can let you trade in stocks, currencies, commodities, as well as for cryptocurrencies. Well, there are separate apps available for everything; you need a one-stop destination. 
  • Fees: You don’t want an app that ends up eating all your profits. The app must have limited fees and no hidden charges. 

Now that the basics are clear, let me help you pick the right app.

5+ Best stock trading apps for iPhone and iPad

1. R StocksTrader: Editor’s Choice

What’s better than trading? Smart trading with the R StocksTrader app. The platform provides safe access to global financial markets, opening better earning opportunities. The app gives real-time price updates of instruments to help you diversify your portfolio with profit-making investments.   

In addition, you don’t have to worry about hopping to different platforms because R StocksTrader gives instant access to 12,000+ instruments to trade, including ETFs.   

As part of its tools, the app has detailed information for each stock, market data, stock charts, corporate actions calendar, financial indicators, and so much more. Moreover, you can invest in fractional stocks and set limit orders for a more controlled investment.  

Is it worth your penny?  

Ideal for beginners- Try the demo account if you are a beginner. Here, you can invest in a real financial instrument without risk. Your capital will be safe while you learn the trading dynamics.   

Updated stats- RoboMarkets StocksTrader app gives real-time updates on stock price fluctuations and market conditions. The individual newsfeeds, watchlists, and charts make understanding complex data easy.   

Multi-asset collection- The app has more than 12,000 financial instruments to invest in. Here, you can access stocks, EFTs, commodities, and precious metals like gold and silver.   

Economical- R StocksTrader claims to have the lowest stock commission fees. You also don’t have to pay any monthly fees.   

Pros

  • Multiple instruments  
  • Free demo account  
  • Low commission fees  
  • Timely notifications for market changes  

Cons

  • No cons found  

Price: Free   

Download

2. Fidelity Investments: Best for mutual funds

A value-driven app offering $0 trades, excellent research tools, and a user-friendly mobile app, Fidelity is indeed funding my retirement plans.

Thus, Fidelity is the best stock app for investors. Unlike other trading apps, it does not charge additional fees for penny stocks. The app also offers many zero-expense ratio mutual funds, which refer to self-indexed funds for individual investors.

These funds include Fidelity ZERO Total Market Index Fund (FZROX) and Fidelity ZERO International Index Fund (FZILX).

Is it worth your penny?

  • Best for research: The app delivers value to its clients. Whether you are viewing stocks, mutual funds, or ETFs, you can have them analyzed in excruciating detail before making a purchase. 
  • Smooth for day trading: Fidelity Active Trader Pro desktop is the best platform for day trading. Hands down!
  • Winner for beginners: The app comes with many resources (videos and podcasts) for beginners to understand trading. 
  • Enhanced voiceover: Fidelity comes with an enhanced voiceover experience and dynamic type.

Pros

  • Screening for trade ideas
  • Customizable dashboard
  • 22 different drawing tools
  • Permission to invest in fraction shares
  • International trading in 25 countries

Cons

  • The active trading department must be improved.

My two cents: Fidelity is not meant for active trading. Download it for investments.

Price: Free

Download

3. E*TRADE: Best for day trading

One of the first online brokerage firms in the US, ETRADE, started operating in 1982 and has been a user favorite ever since. The app’s Power ETRADE platform is the best for options trading and active trading.

The app lets you trade during pre and post-hours at an ECN fee of $0.005/share. ECN fees are the cumulative amount that you are charged for buy and sell orders.
While you can have regular stock and ETF trades at $0, option trades run at $0 + $0.65/share.

ETRADE charges $6.95 for penny stocks. Initially built as a web-based platform, it has grown into one of the best stock broker apps.

Is it worth your penny?

  • Sleek design: The app comes with an appealing design and offers diversity in trading tools. 
  • Chart IQ: Powered by Chart IQ, the app comes with extremely smooth panning and zooming 114 optional technical indicators, and technical analysis. 
  • Tools for beginners: E*TRADE comes with many research and analysis tools such as StrategySEEK, LiveAction, Snapshot Analysis tool, etc.

Pros

  • Educational libraries for everyone
  • Banking services across the US
  • Chart IQ-powered charts with more than 10 user-friendly indicators

Cons

  • Does not support international trading

My two cents: It stands out as one of the best resources for day trading. Give it a shot if you are a beginner.

Price: Free

Download

4. Robinhood: Best for beginners

A one-stop destination, Robinhood lets you invest or trade in cryptocurrencies, stocks, ETFs, or options. The tool is optimized for beginners and designed to highlight the core basics for you. 

It is safe to say its simplicity is its greatest strength. It gives an insight into real-time purchases, which helps you solidify your research. With parameters such as ‘people also bought,’ you can frequently see the hot stocks updated to make your purchase.

Don’t forget to taste Robinhood Snacks, a delicacy serving newsletter and podcast. I have been a subscriber for a long time now. It is the best in the market. 

Most of the online stock trading apps do not offer trading cryptocurrencies. This makes Robinhood an exceptional app on the list. Apart from this, it also offers a cash management service for its users. You can have your debit card under this scheme.

Is it worth your penny?

  • Automated investments: With tools like recurring investment tools and dividend reinvestment tools, the app will automate your investment cycle.
  • Clean design:  Robinhood is the perfect example of simplicity at its best. With a design that simple, you can see yourself becoming the master in a couple of weeks.
  • Robinhood Gold: Avail this service for day trading. The package is quite steep and sells at $5/month.

Pros

  • One-stop solution for crypto and stock, funds, and options
  • Multiple tools to guide you with purchases
  • Commission-free
  • Award-winning design

Cons

  • Poor research tools

Price: Free

Download

5. Ally: Best for banking benefits

A one-stop destination for high-quality checking, savings, and investment accounts. It is a perfect combo of an investment bank and an online brokerage.

With a zero-commission app, you need not pay charges for stock or ETF trades. However, you need to pay 50 cents flat per options contract for an options trade and $9.95 for no-load mutual funds.

The app lets you automate your investment with one of their portfolio strategies. And monitor the goal progress using Goal Tracker.

I admire the platform because it lets me set up recurring transfers to my investment account. I research with the app’s tools, set my portfolio up with real-time support, and work on my profits with my skills. What more can I possibly ask for!

Is it worth your penny?

  • One-stop destination: It provides both banking and investment opportunities on the same app, increasing the convenience factor.
  • Commission-free trade: Eligible US stocks and ETFs are commission-free. Invest as much as you can!

Pros

  • Universal access from any device
  • No minimum deposit

Cons

  • Works great only if you are a valuable customer to the bank.

Price: Free

Download

6. Webull: Best stock app for minors

An insightful community experience to target young traders and investors. Well, it may not offer mutual funds, bonds, or futures; it is offering $0 ETFs/stocks as well as $0 crypto trades.

Webull also stands out as one of the few trading apps in the market, with no minimum deposit. Yes, you don’t need to have $1000 to trade unless you are shorting stocks.

Shorting stocks refers to selling stocks to the market at a higher price and then buying them when the market goes down.

The charts on the app are super clean and easy to use. With that being said, they come in with more than 50 indicators and multiple layouts to compare these charts. Webull also offers screeners, analyst ratings, price targets, and lists of ETFs.

Is it worth your penny?

  • Community-driven: Unique social community features to engage the young audience spreading awareness about investing at an early age. 
  • $0 option trades: While most companies charge $0.65-$0.75 for options, Webull charges you nil. 
  • Universal interface: The mobile app UI resembles the website, making it more straightforward to understand the momentum and easy to use. 

Pros

  • Allows shorting
  • Dozen crypto in your wallet
  • Consistency across multiple devices and OS with a similar UI
  • Get advanced real-time options for data

Cons

  • More research materials should be provided

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts from $1.99)

Download

In today’s tech-advanced world, trading stocks seems like a game of chess.

You may also like to read:

  • Best Cryptocurrency Apps for iPhone and iPad
  • How to manage multiple watchlists in Stocks on iPhone
